authorization: User requested all backlog improvement ideas to be tested; document using standard terminology.
primary_cohort: Unchanged validation: 325639 users, one hidden positive Linux target, fixed inputs and exclusions, 6630 candidates.
primary: Whole-validation NDCG@10; Recall@10 secondary; no frank-based selection.
adoption: Paired NDCG bootstrap 95% lower bound >0; no loss in Recall, game-macro NDCG, target support 1-999 NDCG; empty users do not increase. Compare with current same-family v2 selection. Hybrid/new collaborative versus Item-KNN control.

bootstrap.interpretation: Post-selection exploratory uncertainty, not independent confirmation; multiple candidates are not multiplicity-adjusted.

rank_rules: Top10 strictly positive finite scores; App ID ascending ties; retain empty users in denominator; exclude all observed inputs; no fill except explicit popularity-fill ablation.

rp3beta.note: Standard RP3beta is user-item-user-item recommendation. It reweights existing item cooccurrences; it cannot by itself connect item pairs with zero shared train users.

ease.solver: Exact positive-definite solve; candidate inverse columns may be solved in blocks; abort on resource/numerical failure without labeling a truncated catalog as full EASE.

ials.query: Fixed-item-factor user fold-in from visible query positives only

graph.playtime_training_weight: Per-game percentile rank of log1p snapshot playtime; weight .5+percentile; missing=.5; train accepted lineage only.
graph.time_training_weight: Review-age exponential half-life 3 years relative to latest TRAIN review; weight in cooccurrence and support.

content.long_description: Prefer C about_the_game, then detailed_description, then frozen A-first short description; content snapshot versions unchanged.
content.missing_description_fill: Only unsupported Linux items; pinned frank game metadata first, public Steam appdetails fallback; no review outcomes/statistics as content.
content.sentence_embedding: Pinned multilingual model revision, actual inference, normalized item vectors and mean-profile cosine; record truncation and runtime.
content.train_review_body: Accepted train accounts and review IDs only; deterministic cap 100 reviews per item; hash-based or source-order selection fixed before metrics, no validation/test review text.

query.recency_reference: Latest visible query timestamp, never hidden target timestamp.
query.negative_playtime_reliability: Downweight negative input by 1/(1+log1p(minutes)/log1p(6000)); unavailable feature remains missing, no fabricated playtime.
query.popularity_fill: Only empty top10 slots, train positive counts, never replace personalized slots; report fill hits/users/slots.

fusion.adaptive_content_weight: weight/(1+candidate_train_support/1000); fixed threshold, not fit to frank.
fusion.models: Current v2-selected KNN and content; after validation selection, also compare the frozen best eligible new same-family models with the same grid.

reranking.candidate_generation: Union of top50 from current KNN and content; never inject target into inference candidates.
reranking.validation: Deterministic user-key modulo 3 cross-fitting: each predicted user excluded from ranker fit. Unjudged candidates are weak relevance 0, not observed dislike.
reranking.new_reference: Refit fixed selected ranker on complete validation only after selection lock; frank remains reference.

review_cap_validation.label: Reporting-only sample, not a reproduction of frank collection.

auxiliary_evaluations.temporal_evaluation: Use a global train cutoff and later held-out query-target chronology; if no independently train-fitted chronological model exists, label snapshot/sequence audit and do not claim future-prediction performance.
auxiliary_evaluations.duplicate_and_series_audit: Exact normalized titles/descriptions and high-similarity pairs; do not automatically equate a series sequel with same game.
auxiliary_evaluations.usage: Report current controls and frozen selected models, same-cohort paired comparisons only. Never use auxiliary/frank outcomes to choose primary model settings.

completion: Every backlog row mapped to measured result, completed diagnosis, or concrete failed run/missing prerequisite with evidence; no invented scores, no silent skipped models.
conditional_items: ELSA only if full EASE fails from memory; SASRec feasibility after chronological validation; user_games coverage audit before any playtime augmentation
preserve: Do not modify v1/v2 code, protocols, manifests, splits, models, or reports.
